about.label: Who We Are
about.heading: Qatar's Premier MEP Engineering Partner
about.p1: Teknomech MEP has been delivering world-class mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection solutions across Qatar for over 15 years. Our multidisciplinary teams combine deep engineering expertise with a commitment to quality and safety.
about.p2: From high-rise commercial towers to industrial facilities and government infrastructure, we engineer systems that perform — on time, within budget, and beyond expectations.

whyUs.label: Why Choose Us
whyUs.heading: The Teknomech Advantage
whyUs.p: We combine technical excellence with deep knowledge of Qatar's regulatory landscape, delivering projects that meet the highest international standards while respecting local requirements.
whyUs.feature1Desc: All works comply with Qatar Civil Defence and UPDA regulations
whyUs.feature2Desc: Design, supply, install, test and commission — all under one roof
whyUs.feature3Desc: Arabic and English speaking engineers ready to support you
whyUs.feature4Desc: Full workmanship warranty and AMC maintenance contracts available
